name: The Assay Bloom

stars.name: Assay Bloom
stars.notes: Steady, flare-shy dwarf whose luminosity varies less than one part in ten thousand; survey crews calibrate instruments against it.

planets.name: Whetstone
planets.notes: Sun-scorched iron world scraped by automated slag-runners feeding the inner refineries.

planets.name: Kilndown
planets.notes: Hot dust world where domed glasshouses trial drought crops for export.

planets.name: Grainledger
planets.notes: Breadbasket of the Reaches; its terrace-grain shipments anchor the whole system's economy.

planets.name: Mirrormere
planets.notes: Storm-wrapped seas of reflective plankton blooms; chartered for study but never settled.

planets.name: Grandweight
planets.notes: Principal helium-3 skim site in the sector, ringed by collection barges.

planets.name: Frostpenny
planets.notes: Outer volatile reservoir hosting a small cryominer contingent.

asteroid_belts.name: Kiln Divide
asteroid_belts.notes: Thin debris ring worked over by claim-jumpers; Corvane patrols sweep it twice a season.

asteroid_belts.name: Ledgerline Belt
asteroid_belts.notes: Licensed extraction under Ascendancy charter; refined metal feeds the station foundries directly.

stations.name: Scalehouse Orbital
stations.notes: Primary grain auction floors and futures pits; prices set here ripple half a sector outward.

stations.name: Warden Tally
stations.notes: Corvane customs picket auditing every inbound hull's manifest before berth assignment.

stations.name: Deepvault
stations.notes: Foundry-and-vault complex where bullion reserves back the region's letters of credit.

faction_control.notes: Administered as a charter province; tariffs are steep but predictable and contracts are enforced without appeal.

history: Surveyed during the second Corvane expansion wave and named for the golden pollen-like haze its dust seasons raise at sunset.
Grainledger's great terracing project turned a marginal colony into the Reaches' surplus supplier within two generations.
The Ascendancy now mints regional letters of credit against Deepvault reserves, making the system financially load-bearing.
description: The Assay Bloom burns a steady, unremarkable yellow at the heart of six tidy orbits, its light so constant that survey crews still calibrate against it. Inward the worlds run hot and dry; outward they swell through Mirrormere's storm-laced oceans, the banded bulk of Grandweight, and the pale shelf of Frostpenny. At dusk the planet-wide grain haze lends the whole system its name.

Nearly everything grown, mined, or skimmed here is weighed, taxed, and resold through Scalehouse Orbital, whose floors set prices half a sector away. Corvane customs cutters make the queues long but the paperwork honest, and merchants pay for the certainty. Roughly two and a half million residents call the system home, most of them station-born factors and haulers.

Deepvault's bullion reserves are rumored to have been quietly drawn down twice without any public record. Mirrormere's reflective blooms answer to no known ecology, yet biotech consortia keep buying sampling licenses regardless. Independent runners whisper that the Kiln Divide hides more than claim-jumpers.
